# D'Zizi Petroleum Services Limited

> D'Zizi Petroleum Services Limited is Kenya's leading supplier, installer, and maintainer of petrol station equipment. We design and build complete petrol stations from the ground up, supply certified petroleum equipment, and provide ongoing maintenance and compliance support across all 47 counties of Kenya.

## About

D'Zizi Petroleum Services Limited is a fully licensed petroleum engineering firm based in Nairobi, Kenya. We are EPRA (Energy and Petroleum Regulatory Authority) compliant and serve petroleum operators, fuel retailers, industrial depots, and commercial fleet owners across the country.

- **Founded**: Over 10 years in the petroleum industry
- **Headquarters**: Nairobi, Kenya
- **Contact**: +254 702 587 919
- **Email**: info@dzizipetroleum.co.ke
- **WhatsApp**: https://wa.me/254702587919
- **Website**: https://dzizipetroleum.co.ke

## Core Services

### Petrol Station Installation Kenya
We install complete petrol stations end-to-end: site assessment, civil works coordination, underground tank installation, fuel line laying, dispenser installation, canopy setup, and EPRA inspection readiness. We are one of the most experienced petrol station installation companies in Kenya, having delivered projects in Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Eldoret, Nakuru, and across the country.

### Underground Fuel Tank Installation
Supply and installation of double-wall fibreglass and steel underground storage tanks (USTs) in sizes from 10,000 L to 40,000 L and above. All tanks are EPRA and NEMA compliant. We coordinate excavation, bedding, backfill, manhole and sump installation, and issue pre-commissioning hydrotest certificates.

### Fuel Dispenser Installation
Supply, installation and commissioning of single-nozzle, twin-nozzle and multi-product fuel dispensers. We connect sub-pumps, calibrate flow meters to WMA standards, configure electronics and train station staff.

### Fuel Piping Systems
Installation, repair and maintenance of suction lines, vent lines and offloading pipework using EPRA-approved HDPE and double-wall flexible pipe. All pipework is pressure-tested on completion and issued with certified test reports.

### Tank Hydrotesting Kenya
Pre-commissioning and periodic pressure testing of underground and above-ground fuel storage tanks. We issue certified hydrotest reports accepted by EPRA and insurance providers.

### Tank Calibration Kenya
Wet and dry calibration services for USTs and ASTs. We issue WMA (Weights and Measures Authority) compliant calibration reports essential for EPRA licensing and accurate fuel dispensing.

### EPRA Compliance Support
We guide petroleum business owners through the EPRA licensing process, preparing technical documentation, ensuring equipment meets regulatory standards, attending inspections and resolving compliance deficiencies.

### Petrol Station Maintenance Kenya
Scheduled and emergency maintenance for petrol station forecourts: pump servicing, line testing, leak detection, dispenser calibration, and generator servicing. Available 24/7 for emergency breakdowns.

### Petroleum Equipment Sales
We supply a full range of EPRA-aligned petroleum equipment: underground and above-ground storage tanks, fuel dispensers, submersible pumps, ATGs, air compressors, standby generators and fuel management systems.

### Commercial Site Fuel System Maintenance
Full-service maintenance contracts for fuel depots, industrial yards, mining sites, and commercial fleet fuelling points.

### Tank Fabrication & Repairs
Custom steel above-ground tank fabrication and structural repairs for USTs and ASTs. Includes post-repair hydrotesting and re-calibration.

### Canopy Fabrication & Installation
Custom design, steel fabrication and on-site installation of petrol station forecourt canopies, including lighting and brand signage integration.

### Fuel Line Pressure Testing
Pre-commissioning and periodic pressure testing of fuel distribution pipework. EPRA-accepted certificates issued on completion.

### Petrol Station Equipment Supply & Maintenance
Complete one-stop supply, installation, commissioning and ongoing lifecycle maintenance for all petrol station equipment types.

### Pump Spare Parts
Genuine spare parts for fuel dispensers and submersible pumps: nozzles, hoses, filters, seals, flow meters and electronic components.

### Transportation Services
Safe, insured logistics for petroleum equipment, underground tanks, dispensers and heavy parts to any location across Kenya.

### Station Electrical Installation
Electrical systems design, installation and commissioning for petrol station forecourts: distribution boards, dispenser wiring, pump control panels, lighting and generator transfer switches.

### Branding Works
Forecourt branding installation: canopy fascia signage, illuminated totem signs, dispenser livery, price boards and site wayfinding. Works to oil company brand manuals.

## Service Areas

D'Zizi Petroleum Services operates throughout Kenya including:
Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Eldoret, Nakuru, Thika, Nyeri, Meru, Machakos, Kitale, Malindi, Garissa, Kisii, Kakamega, Embu, and all major towns and counties.
